name: Noire
bio: Archetype: Ultimate Cycling, Reuse, Debuff. ⌽ At turn start: gains 1 Moxie and inflicts [Spotlight] on the healthiest enemy (by percentage). ⌽ Noire's attacks on [Spotlight]ed enemies randomly inflict [Rigidity], [Poison] or [Burn]. ⌽ S1 focuses all [Neg Stats] onto a single enemy. ⌽ Gains [Genius Inspiration] when inflicting [Spotlight] and when casting S2, increasing Ult reuse chance. ⌽ Ult deals more damage for each type or layer of [Neg Stats] on the enemy.
